To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the system can be trained on the annotations of a single fact-checking organization and achieve good performance on that organization, and (ii) it is also effective on other organizations, and even on a union of multiple organizations, and (iii) the system can detect check-worthy claims in both Arabic and English.
1) the system can detect check-worthy claims with a precision of 0.80 and recall of 0.60, 2) the system can be trained on any text, and 3) it is available online at http://claimrank.cs.cornell.edu/.

ClaimRank can be used to: (1) detect check-worthy claims with an F1 of 0.73 (0.70) in Arabic (English), and (2) detect check-worthy sentences with an F1 0.79 (0.77), and (3) detect check-worthy paragraphs with an F1 score of 0.83 (0.82) for Arabic (English).
